basis: The dashboard legend runs from pale yellow at the bottom ('Low') to dark maroon at the top ('High'), and the footer caption explicitly states that 'darker color means higher true value.' On the map, the California (CA) polygon is filled with the darkest maroon shade, matching the top of the scale (near 100). By comparison, the Tennessee (TN) polygon is the lightest shade (pale yellow, near 20), and the Delaware (DE) polygon is a medium orange shade (roughly 40-60). Because CA has the darkest fill on the shared scale, it encodes the highest incidence value among the three candidate states. Applying the routing criterion 'Highest incidence state in the dashboard' to these bounded values settles the comparison in favor of California.
option_label: Open California (CA) incidence detail for priority follow-up
